ἐφηγ-έομαι ,
A.lead to a place: c. dat. pers., esp. as Att. law-term, lead the magistrate to a place where a criminal lay concealed, whom the informer durst not seize himself, D. 22.26 , cf. 26.9 , Poll. 8.50 .
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
